## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. It starts at Dunstable, Bedfordshire.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Mad about animals? Get your hands on Whipsnade Zoo tickets and explore one of Europe's biggest wildlife conservation parks. Discover different zones like Cheetah Rock, Passage Through Asia, Giraffe Heights and Lions of the Serengeti, ride the steam train or explore on foot. It's an animal-tastic adventure
>
> Set in over 600 acres of the beautiful Chiltern Hills countryside, Whipsnade Zoo is an escape from the urban jungle. With over 10,000 amazing animals to discover, including rhinos, tigers, giraffes and elephants, there's a lot of reasons to be wild about Whipsnade Zoo.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €39.01. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 138 ratings and 67 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
